method: Read each assigned journal raw papers.json from git HEAD; compare normalized unique DOI sets against complete paginated publisher-deposited Crossref catalogue. Reference numbers are not official website totals.
access_note: Publisher annual directories directly attempted: ScienceDirect returns HTTP403 for Coordination Chemistry Reviews, Materials Today and Physics Reports; Nature Methods redirects to an unreadable identity service. Computer Use/browser control is unavailable in this environment, so no browser/manual verification is claimed. Public Crossref serves as independently retrieved alternative catalogue; annual scope and DOI-level differences recorded for every source.
